title: Exposure series (series.json)
description: The printer exposes every layer for the time of the file header and ignores times per layer. A longer exposure is therefore several equal layers of `unit_s` with the same image: exposure k is `layers` layers lighting the strips 1 to k.

unit_s.description: Time of one layer (greatest common divisor of the exposures).

print_time_s.description: Estimate with the lift moves between the layers.

section.description: Number of the strip, 1 is the leftmost seen from the copper side.

sections.description: This exposure lights the strips 1 to this number.
